title: Sleeping Together
text: “I know I’ve been busy lately, so I tend to turn in late, but I make up for it by going to bed after breakfast… Motoyasu-kun? Why are you approaching me with that weird look on your face? What are you planning?”
“Father, until Ra— Assistant’s parent arrives, it’ll be brief, but you should lie down here, indeed.”
“What are you talking about, Motoyasu-kun?”
“He’s probably come up with some strange idea again. I’m used to it by now.”

Ren was giving me an oddly cold stare, but this was important, I say. I couldn’t let Father develop dark circles under his eyes from lack of sleep. Ever since I failed to save him from that false accusation, his sleep had grown shallow, and his eyes had taken on a harsh glint. Father normally wore such a gentle expression — I couldn’t bear to let him wear a face that grim again.
“I bet.”
“Ahh…”
“Woof.”

Casting a sidelong glance at Ren and the three slaves, I gently placed a hand against Father’s face, guiding him toward rest with the “big sister” move I’d perfected back in the days I attended school in drag — sharp yet gentle, the kind of expression that made people feel they could rely on me.
“Shall I lull you to sleep with a lap pillow, or perhaps an arm pillow, I say?”
“No, um, that’s—”
“Woof? If Naofumi-sama’s sleeping, then it’s beside me! Owooo!”
And with that, Wolf tried to muscle his way in with dog moves that would’ve put even Keel and Ren to shame.

“On a big bed, Naofumi-sama sleeps snuggled right up against me. I watch Naofumi-sama’s sleeping face while wearing a bathrobe and sipping wine. My family home has a big bed — let’s do that next time.”
What did he just say?! This wolf man! What kind of depraved fantasy was he hurling at Father?!
“What’s the point of that— actually, doesn’t that sound exactly like a scene out of a shoujo manga? What exactly are you two planning to do with me?”
Father, eyes half-lidded, shuffled backward toward Rabbit Guy, Ren, and Crocodile Guy for some reason.
“They probably think there’s no deeper meaning behind it, but their desires are practically leaking out.”
“Can’t argue with that. Their eyes look disturbingly intense.”
“Naofumi, you sure are popular with men. Well, I suppose that’s bound to happen when you fuss over them this much — you even groom my fur sometimes. Are you trying to win me over too?!”
“Could you not say things that sound so misleading? I only groomed you because you were dirty.”
Rabbit Guy and Crocodile Guy stepped in front of Father, as if shielding him from Wolf and me. What on earth were they misunderstanding? Wolf, sure — but I was innocent, I say.
“Step aside, I say. For the sake of Father’s beautiful skin, he needs to be in bed early.”
“Woof, I’m sleeping with Naofumi-sama! Owooo!”
“Would you two calm down. Honestly, if you want him asleep that badly, just stab him with a Sleep Lance or whatever it’s called.”
“I could never do such a thing to Father. What are you even talking about?”
“Wooof?”
“Why are you tilting your head like that, all confused! That’s exactly what you did to Shion and me! Wolf, we all know you can pull off similar attacks too.”
“Woof…”
I genuinely could not fathom why they insisted on getting in my way. All I wanted was to get Father lying down before Rival’s parent arrived — why had it turned into this kind of standoff?
“Shion, please help me protect Iwatani-sama from the beasts here. Sword Hero-sama too.”
“Understood.”
“Sigh… Naofumi, know that this too is something you brought on yourself.”
“No, how does it end up like that? This is definitely the result of Motoyasu-kun doing something bizarre.”
“It’s because you fuss over these three so devotedly. Aren’t you trying to win the men over?”
“How does that follow? Motoyasu-kun, stop saying things that give the wrong impression. And Wolf, don’t just jump on the bandwagon wanting to watch me sleep — stop going along with this nonsense!”

Father protested from behind Rabbit Guy and the others. Hmm… did that mean this approach was a no-go? It didn’t feel wrong to me… So how was I supposed to get Father to sleep? Perhaps I really did need to create a Raph-species based on Big Sister — the one called Raph-chan. Though, thanks to Rafumi, the effect would probably be diluted. That guy’s entire purpose seemed to be tarnishing Big Sister’s image. After all, Big Sister always got bothered whenever Father petted the Raph-species too much.
“I’ll say it again. You beasts over there! You cannot provide Iwatani-sama with peaceful sleep while sharing a bed with eyes that burn with such desire!”
“Hold on, Theo? Aren’t you starting to say some pretty weird things too?”
Crocodile Guy and Ren turned toward Rabbit Guy, brows furrowing.
“Listen carefully. Weren’t we trying to heal Iwatani-sama, prioritizing his safety, wanting him to rest after working himself to the bone? Then this is how it’s done.”
Rabbit Guy settled into what’s called the “loaf” pose, a bit apart from Father. In his beastman form it looked a little odd for someone humanoid, but it came naturally enough to him.
“Iwatani-sama, lean your back against me right here. Go on! Feel free to put your full weight against me.”
“Eh? Ah… um?”
Father did as told, resting his back against Rabbit Guy’s flank. The plush, fluffy fur gently caught and cushioned his back.
“This way, I never lay a single hand on you directly — I simply support Iwatani-sama softly. Lying down beside someone isn’t the only way to do this, you know! Understand?”
“Woof, I see.”
“Grr…”

That was the basic pose Filolial-sama often offered — the fundamental, most essential form of co-sleeping. Ha! Now that I thought of it, just the other day, Father had leaned against a similarly lazy Panda and dozed right off like that. I see! So this was how one provided Father with truly healthy sleep! But this particular technique was beyond me — in my usaunny form, I simply lacked the size for it.
“Theo’s definitely gotten swept up in the weird mood too, right?”
“Amid all this chaos, Theo’s snagged himself quite the prize.”
“Truly a ridiculous exchange happening here, Naofumi.”
“Well, even if you say that to me…”
“Won’t lose. Wooof.”
And with that, Wolf refused to back down, wedging himself against Father’s side, pressing his knee to Father’s back, and settling into a prone position.
“Of course, as an application, when Iwatani-sama rests his weight on my back, I lie prone as well — feel free to think of me as a rug.”
“Naofumi, truly… you really are the Shield Hero. The being celebrated throughout Siltvelt, or so the rumors say.”
“Ren, you’re definitely being sarcastic there. Theo, maybe it’s time you calmed down too?”
Father scolded them, sounding utterly exasperated.
“Well, it seems to have worked on the one who caused all this — Motoyasu.”

Grr… I’d thought Rabbit Guy still had much to learn, but he was actually quite skilled. Never did I imagine there would be something this Motoyasu could learn from you, I say. As I currently stood, I was simply too small — not enough size to pull it off. I was in the middle of researching magic to see whether I could become a Big Usaunny. But little did he know, even without becoming a Big Usaunny, this size problem could be solved just as easily by turning Father into a peckul. HAHAHA! One day, I would let Father revel in fur even more magnificent than Rabbit Guy’s. And just as we were going back and forth like this, Rival’s parent came fluttering down with a great flap of wings.
“You lot… what is this racket in my domain in the dead of night… The commotion reached all the way to my nest.”
Rival’s parent spoke in a tone dripping with bone-deep exasperation. What business did the weakest of dragon emperors have, being exasperated with us?! Know your place, I say.
